protocol.thermochemistry: xTB coupled RRHO with free-rotor treatment below 50 cm^-1
protocol.polar_h_amplification: For molecules with at least two rotatable terminal OH, SH, or NH2 groups, each ETKDG conformer is supplemented with two random polar-H torsion variants and one feasible intramolecular-H-bond variant before optimization
protocol.postopt_rmsd: Kabsch RMSD (reflections allowed) minimised over spyrmsd graph automorphisms, carbon-bound H removed
protocol.mirror_images: chiral conformers are stored with an explicit mirror twin ('mirror_of')
protocol.diastereomer_averaging: Boltzmann average within each diastereomer, equal weight between them
